meta_description: Podcast editing service UK price: £30–£150 per episode for audio, more for video podcasts. What is included and Creator Fellow at £119/mo.

faq.q: How much does a podcast editing service cost in the UK?
faq.a: Usually £30 to £60 per episode for a basic edit, £60 to £150 for a full edit and mix, and £100 to £300 for a video podcast.

faq.q: Is there a monthly podcast editing service in the UK?
faq.a: Yes. ContentFellow's Creator Fellow is £119 a month and includes one podcast edit up to 60 minutes, 8 short videos and a motion graphics video.

faq.q: How long does a podcast edit take?
faq.a: A typical episode is returned within a few working days of receiving the files.
